description: Independent golden longitudes for the ten natal bodies, fetched once from the NASA/JPL Horizons On-Line Ephemeris System. These are TECHNICAL epochs (synthetic instants reused from the precision-regression suite), NOT anyone's birth data.

source.name: NASA/JPL Horizons On-Line Ephemeris System (Solar System Dynamics Group)
source.query: EPHEM_TYPE=OBSERVER, CENTER='500@399' (geocentric), QUANTITIES='31', CSV_FORMAT=YES, EXTRA_PREC=YES, TLIST=<epochsUtc>
source.quantity: ObsEcLon — observer-centered IAU76/80 ecliptic-of-date apparent longitude (light-time, gravitational deflection of light, and stellar aberration applied), degrees
source.timeScaleNote: Horizons time tags are UTC from 1962 on; the 1955 epoch is UT1 (≈UTC within 0.9 s). The sub-arcsecond difference is far inside the tolerance.

frameMatch: Same frame as the provider's Ecliptic(GeoVector(body, date, true)): geocentric, apparent (aberration applied), true ecliptic and equinox of date.
